question: Should ClickClack core ship and maintain this six-format artifact viewer and its browser parsing dependencies?
rationale: The engineering blockers and proof requests are resolved, but the patch establishes a substantial new product surface and continuing parser-security responsibility that cannot be accepted without maintainer intent.

options.title: Sponsor full viewer
options.body: Accept all six formats with the current safety invariants and regression coverage as an ongoing core responsibility.

options.title: Narrow initial formats
options.body: Defer DOCX conversion or syntax highlighting to reduce dependency and attacker-controlled parsing exposure before merge.

options.title: Keep download-only
options.body: Decline the new core viewer boundary and retain hardened downloads for document attachments.

recommendation.title: Sponsor full viewer
recommendation.body: Accept all six formats with the current safety invariants and regression coverage as an ongoing core responsibility.

likelyOwner.reason: His release commit introduced the attachment, upload-documentation, and chat-shell behavior that defines the current product boundary.
